description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for collecting, managing, and formatting transmission metrics related to RLC (Radio Link Control) in a wireless communication system. Includes metrics for SDUs, PDUs, retransmissions, latency, and mode-specific statistics (TM, UM, AM). Provides interfaces for metrics collection and formatting functions for reporting.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_higher
classes.description: Tracks high-level transmission metrics such as SDUs, dropped SDUs, discarded SDUs, and discard failures.

classes.name: rlc_tm_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Transparent Mode (TM).

classes.name: rlc_um_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Unacknowledged Mode (UM).

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_poll_latency
classes.description: Tracks latency measurements related to ACK polling in Acknowledged Mode (AM).

classes.name: rlc_am_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Tracks lower-layer metrics specific to Acknowledged Mode (AM), including retransmissions and latency.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_lower
classes.description: Aggregates mode-specific lower-layer metrics for TM, UM, or AM.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics
classes.description: Main structure combining high and low transmission metrics.

classes.name: rlc_tx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Interface class for metrics collection, providing methods to get and reset metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current metrics and increments the collection counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics to initial state.
